entries.en: {host} could not be reached. A GitHub address or a .tgz link is not fetched through the registry: this machine must reach it directly or through a proxy. If the plugin is also published to npm, enter its package name instead.
entries.zh: 无法连接 {host}。GitHub 地址和 .tgz 直链不经过安装源，需要本机能直接访问它或配置代理；如果这个插件也发布到了 npm，请改填包名。

entries.en: {name} was saved, but a higher-priority configuration overrides it, so it is not in effect
entries.zh: {name} 已保存，但被更高优先级的配置覆盖，当前未生效

entries.en: {plugin} is incompatible with DSH {runtime} (requires {requirements}); running it may cause crashes or data loss.
entries.zh: {plugin} 与 DSH {runtime} 不兼容（要求 {requirements}），运行它可能导致崩溃或数据丢失。

entries.en: {previous} could not serve the package; retrying through {registry} (registry {index} of {total})
entries.zh: {previous} 不可用，正在改用 {registry} 重试（第 {index} 个源，共 {total} 个）

entries.en: A dependency's install scripts need your permission before the install can continue
entries.zh: 有依赖的安装脚本需要你允许后才能继续

entries.en: A newer run card is available below
entries.zh: 已有更新的运行卡片，请查看下方

entries.en: Allow future versions of this plugin
entries.zh: 允许此插件的后续版本
只在信任这些包时允许。

entries.en: An installed package now resolves to another directory, or the change replaces a package the DSH installation provides. Uninstall a package before installing it from another location.
entries.zh: 已安装的插件包解析到了另一个目录，或者更改替换了 DSH 安装自带的包。从其他位置安装前请先卸载。

entries.en: Browse files in this session's workspace
entries.zh: 浏览会话工作区的文件

entries.en: Cancel installation and return to editing
Cancellation was not confirmed. Installation is being applied; wait for its result. {reason}
entries.zh: 取消请求未得到确认；安装已进入收尾阶段，请等待结果。{reason}

entries.en: Cannot submit right now; try again in a moment.
entries.zh: 当前无法提交，请稍候再试。

entries.en: Choose how to add a plugin
Clear the box to show it again.
Close the panel — reopen it from the tool call
entries.zh: 收起问题面板，可从工具调用重新打开

entries.en: Configure official plugins and install or manage other plugins here. View the built-in plugin list and runtime status in Settings → Built-in plugins.
entries.zh: 在这里配置官方插件，安装和管理其他插件。内置插件列表及运行状态可在「设置 → 内置插件」中查看

entries.en: Could not read all plugins, possibly due to a network problem
entries.zh: 可能由于网络问题，无法读取全部插件

entries.en: Could not show the file location. Try again.
entries.zh: 无法显示文件位置，请重试

entries.en: Current workspace or local application unavailable
entries.zh: 当前工作区或本地应用不可用

entries.en: DSH could not compare the loaded plugins with their files.
entries.zh: DSH 无法将已加载的插件与磁盘上的文件进行比较。

entries.en: Enter a valid package name or address.
entries.zh: 请输入有效的包名或地址

entries.en: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
entries.zh: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的地址

entries.en: Enter an integer from 1 to 50, or leave blank to use the default.
entries.zh: 请填 1–50 的整数；留空表示使用默认值。

entries.en: Enter an internal or private npm registry address starting with http:// or https://. If it requires a login, store the credentials in ~/.npmrc on this machine.
entries.zh: 填写内网或私有 npm 源地址，以 http:// 或 https:// 开头。若为需要登录的源，请把凭据放在本机的 ~/.npmrc 里。

entries.en: Enter the plugin's npm package name
entries.zh: 填入插件 npm 包名

entries.en: Enter the plugin's package name, GitHub repository address, or local directory path.
entries.zh: 输入插件的包名、GitHub 仓库地址或本地目录路径。

entries.en: Hide the “系统外掛” entry in the sidebar
entries.zh: 隱藏側欄的「系统外掛」入口

entries.en: How many searches the auxiliary model may run within one Messages request. Applies only to the Messages API.
entries.zh: 辅助模型在一次 Messages 请求内最多可执行的搜索次数，仅适用于 Messages API。

entries.en: Include the API prefix, such as https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1. The provider appends /messages. Leave blank to restore the default.
entries.zh: 填写含 API 前缀的地址，例如 https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1；程序追加 /messages，留空恢复默认。

entries.en: Include the API prefix, such as https://api.deepseek.com/v1/tools. The provider appends /search or /fetch. Leave blank to restore the default.
entries.zh: 填写含 API 前缀的地址，例如 https://api.deepseek.com/v1/tools；程序追加 /search 或 /fetch，留空恢复默认。

entries.en: Inspect the plugins this deployment ships.
entries.zh: 查看内置部署的插件列表

entries.en: Install a plugin version compatible with this DSH.
entries.zh: 请安装与当前 DSH 兼容的插件版本。

entries.en: Install finished with no new dependency.
entries.zh: 安装完成，没有新增依赖。

entries.en: Install only plugins you trust: they run with your permissions and can damage DeepSeek Harness or leak your data.
entries.zh: 请确认插件来源可信。插件在本机以你的权限运行，来源不明的插件可能损坏 DeepSeek Harness，或读取和泄露你的数据。

entries.en: Installation cancelled; the plugin is not enabled, and downloaded files may remain
entries.zh: 已取消安装，插件未启用，下载的文件可能保留
插件安装失败，可查看安装详情。
插件安装已完成，可查看安装结果。

entries.en: Installation has not been confirmed stopped. Retry cancellation or wait for the installation result. {reason}
entries.zh: 尚未确认安装已停止，请重试取消或等待安装结果。{reason}

entries.en: Installation is being applied and cannot be cancelled. View installation progress.
entries.zh: 安装已进入收尾阶段，无法取消，可查看安装进度。

entries.en: Installation result unavailable. Check the plugin list.
entries.zh: 未能获取安装结果，请检查插件列表。

entries.en: Installation status is unconfirmed. View the installation for details.
entries.zh: 安装状态暂未确认，请查看安装任务了解详情。

entries.en: Installed; restart DSH to load it. {reason}
entries.zh: 已安装，请重启 DSH 加载它。{reason}
单次请求最多搜索次数

entries.en: No key is configured; only conversations using a DeepSeek Account model can search, through the default endpoint.
entries.zh: 未配置密钥；仅使用 DeepSeek 账号模型的对话可以通过默认接口地址搜索。

entries.en: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}); check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry
entries.zh: 所有安装源都无法连接（已尝试：{registries}），请检查网络或代理设置，或更换安装源

entries.en: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}). Check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry and retry.
entries.zh: 所有安装源都无法连接（已尝试：{registries}）。请检查网络或代理设置，或更换安装源后重试。

entries.en: No shared tasks yet. Create them through the conversation.
entries.zh: 暂无共享任务，可以通过对话创建

entries.en: No write permission; the plugin cannot be installed
entries.zh: 没有写入权限，无法安装

entries.en: Not a file or a directory, so it cannot be opened.
entries.zh: 这不是文件或目录，没法打开。

entries.en: Off by default: search runs through DeepSeek Messages. For the new Web Search API's features and pricing, see the
entries.zh: 默认关闭，搜索通过 DeepSeek Messages 完成。新版 Web 搜索 API 功能与计费详见

entries.en: On-demand Official plugins offer Update when their version differs from DSH. To update other plugins, uninstall and reinstall them.
entries.zh: 按需安装的官方插件会在版本与 DSH 不同时提供“更新”。其他插件请先卸载再安装新版。

entries.en: Once allowed, the scripts run here with your permissions, and the permission is saved in this profile.
entries.zh: 允许后，脚本会以你的权限在本机运行，授权保存在当前 profile，之后不再询问。

entries.en: Other configuration still uses this bundle's components; switch them off first.
entries.zh: 其他配置仍在使用这个组合包的组件，请先停用它们
已暂停 · 剩余 {seconds} 秒

entries.en: Please select an option or enter a custom answer.
entries.zh: 请选择一个选项或填写自定义答案。

entries.en: Plugin management needs it; it cannot be switched off or uninstalled.
entries.zh: 插件管理所需，不能停用或卸载

entries.en: pnpm blocked install scripts; allow them under allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml and retry
entries.zh: 有依赖的安装脚本被 pnpm 拦下，请在 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 的 allowBuilds 中放行后重试

entries.en: pnpm was not found, so nothing can be installed
entries.zh: 没有找到 pnpm，无法安装
准备调用 Cordis 工具

entries.en: Rendering failed in {slot}; the default UI was restored:
entries.zh: {slot} 渲染失败，已恢复默认界面：

entries.en: Replace this with the actual Git repository address.
entries.zh: 请替换为实际的 Git 仓库地址

entries.en: Replace this with the actual path to your local plugin directory.
entries.zh: 请替换为本机插件目录的实际路径

entries.en: Reply sent; the panel could not close.
entries.zh: 回答已发送；面板未能关闭。
回答先前等待中的问题

entries.en: Restart DSH to apply the change. {reason}
entries.zh: 请重启 DSH 使更改生效。{reason}

entries.en: Results returned per query: an integer from 1 to 50, default 10. This controls result count, not search calls. web_search keeps no more sources than its own result limit.
entries.zh: 每个查询返回的结果条数，须为 1–50 的整数，默认 10；不控制搜索调用次数。web_search 保留的来源数不超过其自身的结果上限。

entries.en: Run controls live in the Cordis panel above Settings
entries.zh: 运行控制在左下角设置上方的 Cordis 面板
Search / Fetch API 基础地址

entries.en: Set up the DeepSeek search provider.
entries.zh: 设置 DeepSeek 的搜索提供方。

entries.en: Something went wrong during the install; the details say what
entries.zh: 安装过程中出错，原因见安装详情
当前 DSH 对应来源

entries.en: Stored outside the settings file. Leave blank to keep the current key.
entries.zh: 不写入设置文件。留空表示保持当前密钥。

entries.en: Supports npm packages, Git repositories, and local directories
entries.zh: 支持 npm 包、Git 仓库和本地目录

entries.en: That directory is gone. It may have been moved or deleted.
entries.zh: 这个目录不在了。可能已被移动或删除。

entries.en: That directory is outside the workspace, so the sidebar will not read it.
entries.zh: 这个目录在工作区之外，侧栏不会读取它。

entries.en: The answer did not arrive before work continued; submit it again.
entries.zh: 回答未送达，工作已继续，请再提交一次。

entries.en: The change reaches a plugin running outside the plugin list.
entries.zh: 更改涉及一个不受插件列表管理的插件。

entries.en: The change reaches modules DSH itself loaded.
entries.zh: 更改涉及 DSH 自身已加载的模块。

entries.en: The disk is full; the install stopped
entries.zh: 磁盘空间不足，安装已停止

entries.en: The downloaded package failed its integrity check
entries.zh: 下载的安装包校验失败

entries.en: The Host has no active installation with this request id. Check the plugin list before trying again.
entries.zh: 后端当前没有此安装任务。请检查插件列表后再尝试安装。

entries.en: The installation result was not received. Check installation status. {reason}
entries.zh: 未收到安装结果，请核对安装状态。{reason}

entries.en: The npm registry the plugin is downloaded from
entries.zh: 从哪个 npm 源下载插件

entries.en: The path does not exist or is not a valid plugin package
entries.zh: 该路径不存在或不是有效的插件包

entries.en: The pending script approvals changed; install again to refresh them.
entries.zh: 待允许的安装脚本列表已变化，请重新安装以刷新

entries.en: The plugin could not be installed
The plugin could not be looked up: {reason}
The plugin package name is the npm package name (like dsh-xxx or @author/plugin): the part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in a community plugin's README install command.
entries.zh: 插件包名即 npm 包名（如 dsh-xxx 或 @作者/插件名），社区插件的 README 安装命令中 dsh plugin add 或 pnpm add 之后的部分。

entries.en: The plugin registry could not be reached; check the network and try again
entries.zh: 无法连接插件源，请检查网络后重试

entries.en: The profile patch cannot address this one uniquely.
entries.zh: 当前 profile 的 patch 无法唯一定位这一项

entries.en: These packages have install scripts that pnpm did not run.
entries.zh: 以下包声明了安装脚本，pnpm 默认不运行。

entries.en: This deployment exposes no plugin views.
entries.zh: 本部署没有开放任何插件视图。

entries.en: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.
entries.zh: 本部署没有可管理的 profile，无法安装或启停插件。

entries.en: This is not a package name or address that can be installed: {reason}
entries.zh: 无法识别这个包名或地址：{reason}

entries.en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be installed as a plugin: {reason}
entries.zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，无法作为插件安装：{reason}

entries.en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be managed as a plugin.
entries.zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，不能作为插件管理

entries.en: This package is already installed; uninstall it before installing another version.
entries.zh: 这个包已经安装；要安装其他版本，请先卸载它

entries.en: This package is not owned by the profile, or plugin management needs it.
entries.zh: 这个包不属于当前 profile，或者是插件管理所需的组件

entries.en: This plugin is already installed. To upgrade it, uninstall it and install it again
entries.zh: 该插件已安装。如需升级，请卸载后重新安装

entries.en: This plugin is incompatible with the running DSH version; running it may cause crashes or data loss.
entries.zh: 这个插件与当前 DSH 版本不兼容，运行它可能导致崩溃或数据丢失。

entries.en: This plugin pack contains no components.
entries.zh: 这个插件包不包含任何组件。

entries.en: This plugin ships with DSH; upgrading DSH updates it
entries.zh: 该插件随 DSH 提供，升级 DSH 即可获得新版本

entries.en: This profile applies changes only at startup.
entries.zh: 这个 profile 只在启动时应用更改。

entries.en: This profile runs without HMR; stop it and uninstall the package with dsh plugin.
entries.zh: 这个 profile 没有启用 HMR，正在使用的包要停止后用 dsh plugin 卸载

entries.en: This session has no workspace directory.
entries.zh: 这个会话没有工作区目录。

entries.en: Too many entries, showing only some of them.
entries.zh: 条目太多，只显示了一部分。

entries.en: Under pnpm's supply-chain security policy (minimumReleaseAge), versions published more recently than the required age are not installed automatically, so this installation used {installed} instead of the latest version {version}. A newly published version has not completed this waiting period and may contain undetected malicious code or defects. If you need {version}, uninstall the current version and then install {exact} to request that version.
entries.zh: 根据 pnpm 供应链安全策略（minimumReleaseAge），发布时间未满规定时长的版本不会被自动安装，因此本次安装的是 {installed}，而非最新版本 {version}。新发布的版本尚未经过该观察期，可能存在未被发现的恶意代码或缺陷。如确需使用 {version}，请先卸载当前版本，再安装 {exact} 以指定该版本。

entries.en: Uninstall it and install a version compatible with this DSH.
entries.zh: 请卸载后重新安装与当前 DSH 兼容的版本。

entries.en: Use the new Web Search API
entries.zh: 启用新版 Web 搜索 API
当前 DSH 对应版本

entries.en: Waiting for the Host to accept installation. Cancellation will retry automatically after confirmation.
entries.zh: 正在等待后端接收安装任务，收到确认后会自动重试取消。

entries.en: What it provides goes away once it is uninstalled.
entries.zh: 卸载后它提供的功能会消失。

entries.en: Which package was installed cannot be told from the dependency change.
entries.zh: 无法从依赖变更中确定安装了哪一个包

entries.en: Work continued — you can still answer
